payment.description: When the customer must pay, after invoice or otherwise, copied close to the contract's words. Null if it does not say.

liability.description: Any limit on the supplier's liability, copied close to the contract's words. Null if it sets none.

insurance.description: Any insurance either party must hold, with its amount, copied close to the contract's words. Null if it says nothing.

renewal.description: Whether it renews, continues or can be extended, and the notice to stop or extend it, copied close to the contract's words. Null if it says nothing.

data_protection.description: What it says about handling or protecting data, copied close to the contract's words. Null if it says nothing.

handles_personal_data.description: True if the contract shows the supplier handling personal data for the customer; false otherwise.
